papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of magnetic resonance enterography and intestinal ultrasound for treatment response assessment in Crohn's disease (MANTRA): protocol for a multicentre, non-randomised, multiple-arm, prospective cohort comparison study
papers.authors: Hameed M, Adebusoye B, Mallett S, Soteriou K, De Kock I, Rafiee H
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: MR enterography (MRE) and intestinal ultrasound (IUS) are used to assess therapeutic response in Crohn's disease (CD) follow-up. There is, however, no clear guidance regarding which modality should be used for individual patients or if they are interchangeable. Therefore, clinical practice varies. We will compare the accuracy of MRE and IUS to classify treatment response in CD.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: Multicentre, non-randomised, multiple arm, prospective cohort study of luminal CD patients aged 16 years or older being treated with steroids, immunomodulators, biologics/biosimilars or small molecules with baseline MRE or IUS. The study will be based in three tertiary referral centres, UK (n=2) and Belgium (n=1), with a target sample size of 155 patients. Patients will undergo both MRE and IUS for response assessment within 20 months of baseline scanning, performed within 6 weeks of each other. One scan will be standard care, the other a research intervention. Interpreting radiologists will be masked to the alternative response assessment test. The primary outcome is the comparative accuracy of MRE and IUS for European Crohn's and Colitis Organisation-European Society of Gastrointestinal and Abdominal Radiology treatment response group categorisation compared with multidisciplinary consensus panel reference standard, using all available clinical information. Secondary outcomes include the influence of baseline scanning (MRE or IUS) on response characterisation accuracy, response accuracy of MRE and IUS disease activity scoring systems, management impact for each follow-up imaging modality and patient reported preferences.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: This protocol has been approved by the National Health Service Research Ethics Committee and West of Scotland Research Ethics Committee 1 (24/WS/0121). Participant informed written consent will be obtained. Findings will be disseminated by peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations and patient and public involvement collaborators.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT06800326.

papers.title_zh: 磁振腸造影（MRE）與腸道超音波（IUS）於克隆氏症治療反應評估之診斷準確性比較（MANTRA）：多中心、非隨機、多組別、前瞻性世代比較研究計畫書
papers.abstract_zh:
簡介：磁振腸造影（MRE）與腸道超音波（IUS）皆用於評估克隆氏症（CD）追蹤期之治療反應。然而，目前並無明確指引說明個別病患應採用何種影像模式，或兩者是否可互換使用，因此臨床實務作法不一。本研究將比較MRE與IUS於分類治療反應之準確性。

方法與分析：本研究為多中心、非隨機、多組別之前瞻性世代研究，收案對象為16歲以上正接受類固醇、免疫調節劑、生物製劑/生物相似藥或小分子藥物治療、且具基線MRE或IUS影像之管腔型CD病患。研究將於英國（2家）與比利時（1家）共3家三級轉診醫學中心進行，目標樣本量為155名病患。病患將於基線影像檢查後20個月內接受MRE與IUS兩種影像評估，兩次檢查間隔6週內完成。其中一項為標準照護檢查，另一項為研究性介入。判讀放射科醫師將對另一項反應評估檢查結果採盲法。主要結果為MRE與IUS於ECCO-ESGAR治療反應分組分類之比較準確性，以多學科共識小組（利用所有可得臨床資訊）作為參考標準。次要結果包括基線影像模式（MRE或IUS）對反應分類準確性之影響、MRE與IUS疾病活動度評分系統之反應準確性、各追蹤影像模式對治療決策之影響，以及病患自我報告之偏好。

倫理與傳播：本研究計畫已獲英國國家健康服務研究倫理委員會與蘇格蘭西部研究倫理委員會1（24/WS/0121）核准。將取得參與者書面同意。研究結果將透過同儕審查發表、學術會議報告，以及病患與公眾參與協作者傳播。

試驗註冊號：NCT06800326。

papers.title: Total Neoadjuvant Therapy Versus Long-Course Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: Real-World Tumor Response and Clinical Outcomes
papers.authors: Lunca S, Ong W, Morarasu S, Musina A, Roata C, Zaharia R
papers.abstract: Background: Total neoadjuvant therapy is becoming a preferred option for locally advanced rectal cancer, particularly in patients with high-risk baseline features. However, real-world evidence comparing tumor response, MRI-defined high-risk feature clearance, surgical outcomes, and survival after total neoadjuvant therapy versus conventional long-course chemoradiotherapy remains limited. This study aimed to compare outcomes between total neoadjuvant therapy and long-course chemoradiotherapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer treated in routine clinical practice. Methods: This is a retrospective, single-centre cohort study focused on patients with stage II-III locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma treated with curative-intent neoadjuvant therapy using either total neoadjuvant therapy or long-course chemoradiotherapy. Tumor response was assessed using restaging MRI, clinical complete response, and pathological complete response. Surgical outcomes and overall survival were evaluated. Results: A total of 110 patients were included. Patients treated with total neoadjuvant therapy had a higher baseline disease burden reflected by a greater proportion of cT4 tumors (40.6% vs. 19.2%; p = 0.014). Radiologic tumor-length response and clearance of MRI-defined high-risk features were comparable between treatment strategies. Clinical and pathological complete response rates were numerically higher in the total neoadjuvant therapy group, but the differences were not significant (cCR: 15.6% vs. 6.4%, p = 0.151; pCR: 18.5% vs. 9.7%, p = 0.301). Conclusions: In this real-world cohort, TNT was preferentially used in patients with more advanced baseline disease and showed numerically higher complete response rates, although differences were not statistically significant. Radiologic response, surgical outcomes, and short-term survival were comparable between treatment strategies. These findings support the feasibility of TNT in routine clinical practice but should be interpreted as exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than evidence of treatment superiority.

papers.title_zh: 局部進展期直腸癌之全程新輔助治療（TNT）與傳統長程放化療（LCCRT）比較：真實世界腫瘤反應與臨床結果
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：全程新輔助治療正逐漸成為局部進展期直腸癌的優先選項，尤其在具高風險基礎特徵的病人中。然而，比較TNT與傳統長程放化療在腫瘤反應、MRI定義高風險特徵清除、手術結果與存活之真實世界證據仍有限。本研究旨在比較常規臨床實務中，接受TNT與LCCRT治療之局部進展期直腸癌病人的結果。方法：本研究為單一中心回溯性世代研究，聚焦於接受根治性意圖新輔助治療（TNT或LCCRT）之第II-III期局部進展期直腸腺癌病人。腫瘤反應以再分期MRI、臨床完全緩解（cCR）與病理完全緩解（pCR）評估。並評估手術結果與整體存活。結果：共納入110名病人。接受TNT治療之病人基礎疾病負擔較高，cT4腫瘤比例較高（40.6% vs 19.2%；p=0.014）。放射學腫瘤長度反應與MRI定義高風險特徵清除在兩治療策略間相當。TNT組之臨床與病理完全緩解率數值上較高，但差異未達統計顯著（cCR：15.6% vs 6.4%，p=0.151；pCR：18.5% vs 9.7%，p=0.301）。結論：在此真實世界世代中，TNT優先用於基礎疾病較嚴重之病人，且顯示數值上較高之完全緩解率，惟差異未達統計顯著。放射學反應、手術結果與短期存活在兩治療策略間相當。此結果支持TNT於常規臨床實務中之可行性，但應被解讀為探索性、產生假說之發現，而非療效優越性之證據。
papers.score_reason: 單中心回溯性研究、樣本僅110人且兩組基線嚴重不平衡（TNT組病情較重），結果未達統計顯著，作者自承僅為探索性假說。
papers.relevance_why: TNT vs LCCRT是目前LARC新輔助治療決策的核心臨床議題，直接影響大腸直腸外科日常個案討論。

papers.title: Lower Preoperative Skeletal Muscle Index in Patients with Pathological T4 Colorectal Cancer: An Exploratory Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.authors: Kiss B, Török Á, Sala D, Moriczi R, Gábor S, Muresan G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Low skeletal muscle index (SMI) has been linked to adverse outcomes in colorectal cancer, but its association with local pathological tumor extent is less clear. This study examined whether preoperative CT-derived SMI was associated with pathological T4 disease in patients undergoing colorectal cancer resection.
METHODS: This retrospective single-center observational study included 147 consecutive adults who underwent colorectal resection for histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma between January 2022 and November 2025 and had suitable preoperative abdominal or abdomino-pelvic CT imaging within 90 days before surgery. Skeletal muscle area was measured on a single axial CT image at the L3 level, and SMI was calculated as muscle area/height2. Patients were classified as having pathological T1-3 or T4 disease. Logistic regression assessed the association between SMI, expressed per 5 cm2/m2 increase, and pathological T4 stage.
RESULTS: Patients with pathological T4 tumors had lower SMI than those with T1-3 disease (37.22 vs. 42.85 cm2/m2, p = 0.016). Higher SMI was associated with lower odds of T4 disease in univariable analysis (OR 0.79, 95% CI 0.66-0.94; p = 0.008) and after adjustment for age and sex (OR 0.77, 95% CI 0.63-0.94; p = 0.009).
CONCLUSIONS: Lower preoperative SMI was associated with pathological T4 colorectal cancer in this cohort. Because of the retrospective observational design, causality cannot be inferred. The association should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating and may reflect reverse causality, shared inflammatory-nutritional pathways, or residual confounding.
papers.title_zh: 病理T4大腸直腸癌病人術前骨骼肌指數較低：一項探索性回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景/目的：低骨骼肌指數（SMI）已被證實與大腸直腸癌不良預後相關，但其與局部病理腫瘤侵犯程度的關聯性較不明確。本研究探討術前CT測得之SMI是否與接受大腸直腸癌切除病人之病理T4疾病相關。

方法：本回溯性單中心觀察性研究納入2022年1月至2025年11月間，因組織學確診腺癌接受大腸直腸切除、且術前90天內有適合之腹部或腹骨盆CT影像之147名連續成人病人。骨骼肌面積於L3層級單一軸位CT影像測量，SMI計算為肌肉面積/身高平方。病人分為病理T1-3或T4疾病兩組。以邏輯迴歸評估SMI（每增加5 cm2/m2表示）與病理T4分期之關聯。

結果：病理T4腫瘤病人之SMI低於T1-3疾病病人（37.22對42.85 cm2/m2，p = 0.016）。單變項分析中，較高SMI與較低T4疾病勝算相關（OR 0.79，95% CI 0.66-0.94；p = 0.008），經年齡與性別校正後仍然顯著（OR 0.77，95% CI 0.63-0.94；p = 0.009）。

結論：本世代中，較低之術前SMI與病理T4大腸直腸癌相關。由於回溯性觀察性設計，無法推論因果關係。此關聯應被視為假說產生性質，可能反映逆向因果關係、共同的發炎—營養路徑，或殘餘干擾因子。

papers.title: Effect of Ultra Processed Foods on Cancer Risk and Strategies for Risk Mitigation
papers.authors: DuBroff J, Gow-Lee B, Mahadevan V, Palchaudhuri S, Martindale R
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This review examines the relationship between ultra-processed foods (UPFs) and cancer risk, covering UPF classification systems, epidemiological evidence, food additive regulatory frameworks, biological mechanisms of carcinogenesis, and dietary strategies to reduce risk.
RECENT FINDINGS: A randomized crossover study linked UPF consumption to higher caloric intake and weight gain, implicating metabolic dysfunction in cancer pathogenesis. A 2023 meta-analysis found a 13% increase in overall cancer risk per 10% increment UPF consumption, supporting landmark NutriNet-Santé cohort findings. Recent analysis identified substantial microplastic contamination in protein-based UPFs. UPFs may augment cancer risk through excess caloric intake, obesity, metabolic dysregulation, insulin resistance, chronic inflammation, and exposure to potentially harmful additives and microplastics. Large cohort studies confirm elevated overall cancer risk, with colorectal cancer showing the strongest site-specific association. UPF consumption may displace minimally processed foods, which demonstrate potentially protective effects. Further research and regulatory action are needed to clarify the cumulative effects of multiple food additives.
papers.title_zh: 超加工食品對癌症風險的影響及風險緩解策略
papers.abstract_zh:
本綜述目的：探討超加工食品（UPFs）與癌症風險之間的關聯，內容涵蓋UPF分類系統、流行病學證據、食品添加物法規框架、致癌之生物機轉，以及降低風險的飲食策略。

近期發現：一項隨機交叉試驗發現UPF攝取與較高熱量攝取及體重增加有關，暗示代謝功能障礙在癌症發生中扮演角色。2023年一篇統合分析發現，UPF攝取每增加10%，整體癌症風險增加13%，此結果支持具里程碑意義的NutriNet-Santé世代研究之發現。近期分析發現以蛋白質為基底的UPF中含有大量微塑膠污染。UPFs可能透過過量熱量攝取、肥胖、代謝失調、胰島素抵抗、慢性發炎，以及暴露於潛在有害添加物與微塑膠等機轉來增加癌症風險。大型世代研究證實UPF與整體癌症風險上升有關，其中大腸直腸癌顯示最強的部位特異性關聯。UPF攝取可能取代具潛在保護效果的低度加工食品。仍需進一步研究與法規行動，以釐清多種食品添加物的累積效應。
papers.score_reason: 為敘述性文獻回顧（非系統性），提供UPF與CRC關聯之背景知識，可用於病人衛教，但無新臨床證據可直接改變外科實務。
papers.relevance_why: 文中提及大腸直腸癌為UPF關聯最強之部位特異性癌症，對CRC風險衛教有參考價值，但屬飲食流行病學而非外科介入。
papers.one_liner: 綜述整合多項世代研究與統合分析，UPF攝取每增10%整體癌症風險增13%，大腸直腸癌為關聯最強部位。
papers.action: 衛教病人可建議減少超加工食品、增加低度加工食物攝取；此篇不改變篩檢或手術決策，證據仍屬觀察性。

papers.title: ASK1 in Cancer Cell Death: Insights from In Vitro and In Vivo Studies
papers.authors: O'Neill E, Kornel A, Irwin E, Tsiani E
papers.abstract: Apoptosis signal-regulating kinase 1 (ASK1) is a mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase (MAP3K) involved in stress-induced apoptosis. Increasing evidence indicates that ASK1 activation contributes to the anticancer activity of numerous compounds, particularly those that induce oxidative or endoplasmic reticulum stress. This review summarizes studies demonstrating ASK1-dependent apoptosis in models of lung, breast and gynecologic, or gastrointestinal cancers following treatment with natural products, phytochemicals, and synthetic agents, focusing on mechanistic evidence linking ASK1 to downstream activation of the JNK and p38 MAPK pathways, mitochondrial dysfunction, and caspase-dependent cell death. Studies were selected based on direct experimental validation of ASK1 activation and involvement in the observed anticancer effects. Overall, this review supports ASK1 as a promising molecular target for the development of novel cancer treatment strategies.
papers.title_zh: ASK1在癌細胞死亡中的角色：來自體外與體內研究的見解
papers.abstract_zh: 凋亡訊號調控激酶1（ASK1）是一種參與壓力誘導性凋亡的絲裂原活化蛋白激酶激酶激酶（MAP3K）。越來越多證據顯示，ASK1的活化有助於多種化合物的抗癌活性，特別是那些誘導氧化壓力或內質網壓力的化合物。本綜述總結了在肺癌、乳癌與婦科癌症、或消化道癌症模型中，經天然產物、植化素及合成藥劇治療後展現ASK1依賴性凋亡的研究，並聚焦於連結ASK1與下游JNK及p38 MAPK路徑活化、線粒體功能障礙、以及caspase依賴性細胞死亡的機制證據。所選研究皆基於對ASK1活化及其在所觀察抗癌效應中作用的直接實驗驗證。整體而言，本綜述支持ASK1作為開發新型癌症治療策略之潛力分子靶點。

papers.title: Faecal Calprotectin: A Non-Invasive Marker for Diagnosing and Monitoring Acute Diverticulitis
papers.authors: Mohammed A, Baig Y, Butler A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Acute diverticulitis (AD) is a prevalent gastrointestinal disorder with a significant recurrence rate. Faecal calprotectin (FC) is a non-invasive biomarker of intestinal inflammation, but its role in diagnosing and monitoring diverticulitis remains to be fully established.
OBJECTIVE: This narrative review aims to evaluate the current evidence on the utility of FC in the diagnosis, severity assessment, prediction of recurrence, and monitoring of therapeutic response in patients with diverticular disease (DD) and AD.
METHODS: A structured literature search was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, and ScienceDirect for peer-reviewed original studies published in English between 2004 and April 2025. The search strategy combined terms related to diverticular disease and faecal calprotectin. Studies reporting original data on FC in DD were synthesised narratively.
RESULTS: FC demonstrates significant utility across multiple clinical applications in DD. For diagnosis, FC is markedly elevated in AD (mean 556-695 μg/g) and symptomatic uncomplicated diverticular disease (SUDD) (median 181 μg/g), while remaining normal in irritable bowel syndrome (mean 50 μg/g), enabling differentiation between organic and functional disorders. FC correlates strongly with endoscopic disease severity, with positivity rates increasing from 48.6% in DICA 1 to 93.2% in DICA 3 (p < 0.0001). For predicting recurrence, elevated FC identifies patients at high risk, with one study reporting 87.5% of recurrent cases showing prior FC elevation and a negative predictive value of 96.8%. FC also exhibits excellent short-term prognostic capacity (AUC 0.976 at 3 months) and responds to therapeutic intervention, with significant reductions following successful treatment with probiotics, nutraceuticals, budesonide, and other agents.
CONCLUSIONS: FC is a promising non-invasive biomarker for diagnosing diverticulitis, assessing disease severity, predicting recurrence, and monitoring treatment response. Its ability to detect subclinical inflammation makes it particularly useful for risk stratification. However, the current evidence base consists predominantly of retrospective and observational studies, and standardised thresholds require further validation through prospective trials before routine clinical implementation can be recommended.

papers.title_zh: 糞便鈣衛蛋白：診斷與監測急性憩室炎的非侵入性標記
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：急性憩室炎（AD）是常見的腸胃疾病，復發率顯著。糞便鈣衛蛋白（FC）是腸道發炎的非侵入性生物標記，但其在診斷與監測憩室炎中的角色仍未完全確立。目標：本敘述性回顧旨在評估FC在憩室疾病（DD）與AD病人中，於診斷、嚴重度評估、預測復發及監測治療反應方面的實證證據。方法：以PubMed、Scopus及ScienceDirect進行結構化文獻搜尋，納入2004年至2025年4月間發表之英文同儕審查原創研究，搜尋策略結合憩室疾病與糞便鈣衛蛋白相關詞彙，並以敘述方式綜整具原始數據的研究。結果：FC在DD的多項臨床應用上展現顯著效用。診斷方面，FC在AD中顯著升高（平均556-695 μg/g），在症狀性單純性憩室疾病（SUDD）中亦升高（中位數181 μg/g），而在大腸激躁症（IBS）中維持正常（平均50 μg/g），可用以區分器質性與功能性疾患。FC與內視鏡疾病嚴重度高度相關，陽性率由DICA 1的48.6%上升至DICA 3的93.2%（p < 0.0001）。在預測復發方面，FC升高可辨識高風險病人，一項研究顯示87.5%復發病例先前即有FC升高，陰性預測值達96.8%。FC亦展現優異的短期預後能力（3個月時AUC達0.976），並對治療介入有反應，於使用益生菌、營養補充品、budesonide等藥物治療成功後FC顯著下降。結論：FC是診斷憩室炎、評估疾病嚴重度、預測復發及監測治療反應的一項有潛力的非侵入性生物標記，其偵測亞臨床發炎的能力使其特別適用於風險分層。然而，目前證據多來自回溯性與觀察性研究，標準化切點仍需透過前瞻性試驗進一步驗證，方能建議常規臨床應用。

papers.title: Stress-specific 14-3-3-client modules in digestive cancers: an evidence-graded review of adaptive survival and therapy resistance
papers.authors: Li R, Zhao Z, Wang X
papers.abstract: 14-3-3 proteins are phosphoserine- and phosphothreonine-binding adaptors that regulate client localization, stability and activity under cellular stress. This narrative review synthesizes stress-specific 14-3-3-client modules in gastric, colorectal, pancreatic, hepatocellular and biliary cancers. Modules were classified as high, moderate, early/context-dependent or background according to mechanistic evidence, functional perturbation, client mapping, treatment-state validation and clinical association. In gastric cancer, G3BP stress granule assembly factor 1 (G3BP1) cooperates with YWHAZ-encoded 14-3-3ζ to retain pro-apoptotic Bax in the cytoplasm. In colorectal cancer, SFN-encoded 14-3-3σ restricts Yin Yang 1 (YY1), sustaining the unfolded protein response and chemotherapy tolerance. In pancreatic cancer, SFN-encoded 14-3-3σ interacts with Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1) to promote ribonucleotide reductase expression and gemcitabine resistance. In hepatobiliary cancers, SFN-related modules support anoikis resistance but remain context dependent. Clinically relevant units are stress-specific 14-3-3-client complexes rather than total 14-3-3 expression.
papers.title_zh: 消化道癌症中壓力特異性14-3-3-客體蛋白模組：適應性存活與治療抗性的證據分級回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 14-3-3蛋白是磷酸絲胺酸與磷酸蘇胺酸結合的接合蛋白，在細胞壓力下調控客體蛋白的定位、穩定性與活性。本篇敘述性回顧綜整了胃癌、大腸直腸癌、胰臟癌、肝細胞癌與膽道癌中壓力特異性的14-3-3-客體蛋白模組。這些模組依據機制證據、功能性擾動、客體蛋白圖譜、治療狀態驗證與臨床關聯性，被分類為高度、中度、早期/情境依賴或背景等級。在胃癌中，G3BP應力顆粒組裝因子1（G3BP1）與YWHAZ編碼的14-3-3ζ協同作用，將促凋亡的Bax蛋白滯留於細胞質中。在大腸直腸癌中，SFN編碼的14-3-3σ限制Yin Yang 1（YY1），維持未摺疊蛋白反應與化療耐受性。在胰臟癌中，SFN編碼的14-3-3σ與Yes相關蛋白1（YAP1）交互作用，促進核苷酸還原酶表現與吉西他濱抗藥性。在肝膽癌中，SFN相關模組支持失巢凋亡抗性，但仍屬情境依賴。臨床相關的單位應是壓力特異性的14-3-3-客體蛋白複合體，而非14-3-3總表現量。

papers.title: Recent progress in clinical and molecular biological research in rectal serrated lesions
papers.authors: Zeng X, Xu Y, Liu L
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer ranks among the most common malignancies worldwide. Rectal serrated lesions represent a significant precancerous condition, accounting for approximately 30% of sporadic colorectal carcinomas. Their flat morphology and indistinct borders often lead to missed detection during routine colonoscopy. In addition, the complex classification system and considerable molecular heterogeneity of these lesions create challenges for clinical management, including diagnostic accuracy, risk stratification, and treatment decisions. Research in recent years has progressively clarified the unique oncogenic pathway associated with serrated lesions-referred to as the serrated pathway. Characteristic molecular events include mutations in b-raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B (BRAF) or kirsten rat sarcoma viral proto-oncogene (KRAS) mutations, CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP), and microsatellite instability (MSI). Among these, the BRAF V600E mutation serves as the core driver event. Combination therapy with encorafenib and cetuximab, which targets this mutation, has been shown to improve outcomes in patients with BRAF-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer. Furthermore, Microsatellite Instability-High (MSI-H) lesions exhibit sensitivity to immune checkpoint inhibitors, offering novel options for personalized treatment. Concurrently, the application of technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted endoscopy, molecular imaging, and liquid biopsy holds promise for improving the detection of early-stage lesions. This systematic review examines the current research landscape regarding rectal serrated lesions, covering an evolution of classification systems, elucidation of molecular and cellular mechanism, advances in diagnostic technology, and optimized treatment strategies. We further discussed molecular differences between the serrated pathway and the classical adenoma-carcinoma sequence, epigenetic regulatory mechanisms, tumour microenvironment characteristics, and personalized management strategies based on molecular subtyping. By synthesizing existing evidence, this review aims to provide theoretical guidance for the clinical management of rectal serrated lesions and lay the groundwork for future research.

papers.title_zh: 直腸鋸齒狀病灶的臨床與分子生物學研究近期進展
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌是全球最常見的惡性腫瘤之一。直腸鋸齒狀病灶是一種重要的癌前病變，約佔散發性大腸直腸癌的30%。由於其扁平型態與邊界不清，常規大腸鏡檢查時容易被漏診。此外，其複雜的分類系統與顯著的分子異質性，對臨床管理（包括診斷準確性、風險分層與治療決策）造成挑戰。近年研究已逐漸闡明鋸齒狀病灶特有的致癌路徑——即所謂的鋸齒狀路徑。其特徵性分子事件包括BRAF或KRAS基因突變、CpG島甲基化表型（CIMP）及微衛星不穩定性（MSI）。其中，BRAF V600E突變是核心驅動事件。針對此突變的encorafenib加cetuximab聯合治療，已證實可改善BRAF突變轉移性大腸直腸癌患者的預後。此外，微衛星高度不穩定性（MSI-H）病灶對免疫檢查點抑制劇有敏感性，為個人化治療提供了新選擇。同時，人工智慧（AI）輔助內視鏡、分子影像及液態活檢等技術的應用，有望改善早期病灶的偵測。本系統性綜述檢視直腸鋸齒狀病灶目前的研究現況，涵蓋分類系統的演變、分子與細胞機制的闡明、診斷技術的進展，以及優化的治療策略。我們進一步討論鋸齒狀路徑與傳統腺瘤-癌演變序列之間的分子差異、表觀遺傳調控機制、腫瘤微環境特徵，以及基於分子亞型的個人化管理策略。透過整合現有證據，本綜述旨在為直腸鋸齒狀病灶的臨床管理提供理論指引，並為未來研究奠定基礎。
papers.score_reason: 為敘述性/系統性綜述，整合現有分子生物學與治療證據，無新原始數據；對建立疾病概念有幫助，但短期內不會改變臨床實務。

papers.title: Report from the 27th Annual Western Canadian Gastrointestinal Cancer Consensus Conference on Colorectal Cancer, Calgary, Alberta, 26-27 September 2025: Advances in Colon and Rectal Cancer
papers.authors: Lee-Ying R, Gill S, Box A, Latour H, Strum S, Gordon V
papers.abstract: The 27th annual Western Canadian Gastrointestinal Cancer Consensus Conference (WCGCCC) was held in Calgary, Alberta, on 26-27 September 2025. The WCGCCC is an interactive multidisciplinary conference that was attended by healthcare professionals from across Western Canada (British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba) who are involved in the care of patients with colorectal cancer. Specialists from the fields of medical and radiation oncology, pathology, surgery, and a family physician in oncology participated in presentations and discussions for the purpose of developing the recommendations presented here. This consensus statement addresses recent advances in the management of colorectal cancer in a Western Canadian context, with respect to adjuvant exercise, as per the CHALLENGE trial, adjuvant Aspirin and PI3K testing, as per the ALASCCA trial, adjuvant immunotherapy, as per the ATOMIC trial, the use of encorafenib and an EGFR inhibitor with chemotherapy, as per the BREAKWATER trial, the use of combination immunotherapy as per the CHECKMATE 8HW trial and optimal strategies for omitting radiation and non-operative management of non-metastatic rectal cancer.
papers.title_zh: 第27屆西加拿大腸胃道腫瘤共識會議報告：大腸直腸癌進展（2025年9月26-27日，卡加利，亞伯達）
papers.abstract_zh: 第27屆西加拿大腸胃道腫瘤共識會議（WCGCCC）於2025年9月26-27日在亞伯達省卡加利舉行。WCGCCC是一個互動式多學科會議，與會者為來自西加拿大（卑詩省、亞伯達省、薩克其萬省、曼尼托巴省）參與大腸直腸癌患者照護的醫療專業人員。內科腫瘤科、放射腫瘤科、病理科、外科的專科醫師，以及一位腫瘤科家庭醫師參與了簡報與討論，以制定本文提出的建議。本共識聲明針對西加拿大情境下大腸直腸癌治療的近期進展提出說明，內容涵蓋：依據CHALLENGE試驗的輔助性運動、依據ALASCCA試驗的輔助性阿斯匹靈與PI3K檢測、依據ATOMIC試驗的輔助性免疫治療、依據BREAKWATER試驗使用encorafenib合併EGFR抑制劑與化療、依據CHECKMATE 8HW試驗使用合併免疫治療，以及非轉移性直腸癌省略放療與非手術治療的最佳策略。

papers.title: Optimizing Care Pathways from Screening/Detection to Survivorship for Early Age Onset Cancer Patients in Canada
papers.authors: Raphael M, Brenner D, Chawla T, Matwiy T, Peacock S, Spring R
papers.abstract: The fifth annual pan-tumour Early Age Onset Cancer (EAOC) Symposium, held in November 2025 and organized by the Colorectal Cancer Resource & Action Network (CCRAN), convened clinicians, researchers, policymakers, patients, and caregivers to address the rising incidence of cancers in individuals under 50 years. In addition to discussions around diagnostic and therapeutic advances for patients with late-stage disease, content centered on addressing critical gaps along the EAOC care continuum, including (i) diagnostic delays related to limited awareness and suboptimal primary care pathways, (ii) screening eligibility criteria for colorectal cancer (CRC) that no longer reflect current disease epidemiology, and (iii) insufficient age-appropriate infrastructure to meet the EAOC population's unique unmet needs with respect to psychosocial support, fertility counseling, financial navigation, and survivorship planning. The symposium generated consensus recommendations such as the embedding of EAOC education into medical training curricula to increase the index of suspicion of EAOC in primary care, lowering the CRC screening age to 45 years to match this population's rising disease incidence, and expanding multidisciplinary adolescent and young adult (AYA) and EAOC programs-including through the use of virtual models-to ensure that patients receive coordinated, comprehensive, equitable and age-appropriate care across the country.
papers.title_zh: 從篩檢/偵測到存活照護：優化加拿大早發型癌症（Early Age Onset Cancer, EAOC）病人的照護路徑
papers.abstract_zh: 第五屆泛腫瘤早發型癌症（EAOC）研討會於2025年11月舉行，由大腸直腸癌資源與行動網絡（CCRAN）主辦，集結臨床醫師、研究人員、政策制定者、病人與照顧者，共同探討50歲以下族群癌症發生率上升的議題。除討論晚期疾病病人的診斷與治療進展外，內容聚焦於解決EAOC照護連續體中的關鍵缺口，包括：(i) 因認知不足與基層照護路徑不佳所導致的診斷延遲；(ii) 大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢資格標準已不符合當前疾病流行病學；(iii) 缺乏適齡基礎設施以滿足EAOC族群在心理社會支持、生育諮詢、財務導引及存活照護規劃方面的獨特未滿足需求。本次研討會產出共識建議，例如：將EAOC教育納入醫學訓練課程以提高基層照護對EAOC的警覺性；將CRC篩檢年齡下修至45歲以符合此族群疾病發生率上升的現況；以及擴大多專科青少年與年輕成人（AYA）及EAOC照護計畫（包括運用虛擬照護模式），以確保全國病人獲得協調、全面、公平且適齡的照護。
